name: Warp Gate
description: Runs the Warp Gate client from this package instead of downloading it, so the server that signals cannot also change the code.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' blob:; media-src 'self' blob:; font-src 'self'; connect-src https: http://localhost:* http://127.0.0.1:*; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'
